CAUTIONS TO BE HEEDED WHEN USING THE TEST MODE: In the case where plural machines are linked for communication play, if even one seat enters the test mode, all of the linked seats will enter the test mode. Therefore, if any one of the linked machines is in play, use care so as not to use the test mode. The contents of the setting changes made will not be effective unless the test mode is finished in the test mode. When the setting is changed, be sure to “EXIT” in the menu mode. Do not press the TEST BUTTON during network check at the time of turning the power on or exiting from the test mode. If anyone of the linked machines uses the test mode during network check, all other Seats will continue network checking. Cause all of the Seats to reenter the test mode and then have all of the Seats exit from the test mode simultaneously.
